overview: The Homes collection is the smaller villa offering; Heights and hilltop Mansions are separate products with different sizes and pricing.
The November 2024 launch initially offered Homes and Heights Types 05–08, with other Heights designs and Mansions to follow.
research.locationNote: Nawayef’s eastern hill on Hudayriyat Island, Abu Dhabi. Confirm the plot and outlook; a hilltop position does not guarantee a particular view.
research.priceNote: Modon advertises Homes from AED 6.6 million and Heights from AED 19.3 million; Mansions pricing is to be confirmed. These are separate collection guides, not current unit quotations.
research.paymentNote: The project FAQ describes 10% downpayment, 30% during construction and 60% on handover. Obtain the selected property’s dated schedule.
research.handoverNote: December 2028 is Modon’s published estimate. Confirm the contracted date and progress for the chosen collection.

facts.label: Launch collections
facts.value: Six Homes designs, eight Heights designs and five Mansion designs were announced; these are design counts, not available homes.

facts.label: Ownership
facts.value: Modon advertises freehold ownership for all nationalities; confirm the specific title and purchase terms.
